Quick answers

Before you start

Have another question? Tell us about your business and we will discuss the details.

How much does a website cost?

Waslivo packages start at SAR 799. The final price depends on the number of pages, content, and required features. We define it after discussing the project.

Are hosting and a domain included?

Yes. One year of hosting and a domain are included in the price.

Will the website work on mobile?

Yes. We design and test the interface on different screen sizes.

Will my website appear on Google?

Yes. We prepare websites for indexing so they can appear on Google after being indexed. Timing and ranking depend on Google and other factors.
